cases.description: Swing Angle (a family parameter with two ids in the Architectural link) is one picker item, kind Number, origin Family, binding Instance
manualSteps: Open the sample with the Architectural link and the Model Context panel; tick only the Architectural link.
Filter tab: + New filter, + Condition, open the parameter picker and type 'Swing'.
Exactly one 'Swing Angle' item is listed, tagged Family and Instance, and its value box takes an angle.

cases.description: Mark is a built-in text parameter bound to instances
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, + Condition, type 'Mark' in the picker.
'Mark' is tagged Built-in and Instance; the operator list offers the text operators (contains, begins with ...) and the Aa toggle.

cases.description: Function is an enumerated parameter on wall types
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Walls, + Condition, type 'Function'.
'Function' is tagged Type; the operators are equals / does not equal / empty / defined, and the value box lists Interior, Exterior, Foundation ...

cases.description: Room Bounding has the Yes/No kind from its spec
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Walls, + Condition, pick 'Room Bounding'.
The value box offers Yes and No only.

cases.description: Reference Level on ducts is an element reference
manualSteps: Tick only 'Current model'; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition, pick 'Reference Level'.
The value box takes a level name (for example L3) and the operators are equality only.

cases.description: Actual Number of Risers stays an integer
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Stairs, + Condition, pick 'Actual Number of Risers'.
The operators include is greater than / is less than and the value box takes whole numbers.

cases.description: A shared parameter carried by a model element of the Architectural link is tagged Shared
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, + Condition, type the shared parameter name from sample-facts.json.
The item carries the Shared tag.

cases.description: Models across HVAC and Architectural: Mark is in both documents
manualSteps: Tick 'Current model' and the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, + Condition, type 'Mark'.
Hover 'Mark': the tooltip lists both models under Models.

cases.description: Models across HVAC and Architectural: Swing Angle is in one document only and shows no warning
manualSteps: Tick 'Current model' and the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, + Condition, type 'Swing'.
'Swing Angle' has no warning color; its tooltip lists only the Architectural link under Models.

cases.description: Value counts of Swing Angle on Doors in the Architectural link
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Doors, + Condition, pick 'Swing Angle', operator equals.
Open the value box: the listed values add up to 131 doors out of 142 (11 doors have no Swing Angle).
Check without the panel: open 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.rvt' (do not save), Doors schedule with field Swing Angle, sort and group by it, Grand totals > Count.

cases.description: Catalog build time of the HVAC model and the Architectural link, read from the panel's own Trace lines on a cold cache
cases.expected: Trace lines recorded for both documents
manualSteps: Settings > Logging level Trace, open the Model Context panel on the sample with the Architectural link ticked, Filter tab, + New filter, + Condition.
The log has 'Revit Catalog', 'Revit Catalog samples' and 'Revit Catalog build' lines for both documents; set the level back.

cases.description: Every built-in parameter that Revit's filter dialog does not list, sampled once per element type in all seven documents, finds its own value with an equals rule
manualSteps: Pick any element in the sample (Current model or a link), pick a built-in parameter shown in Properties that View > Filters does not offer (for example a Phasing or Identity Data field).
In the panel make a filter on that element's category with that parameter equals the value shown in Properties: the element is in the result.
